video_title: Kevin Garnett on the time he CUSSED out Pat Riley 🤯

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on his first intense workout with the Minnesota Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: I had never been to a workout like this. That's the first time for them to see me.

text_blocks.speaker: Kevin Garnett
text_blocks.text: I had never been to a workout like this. I do a 90-minute workout by myself. I had never been to a workout like this. That's the first time for them to see me. And then I did a workout Monday, Tuesday. By that Friday, I got an invitation to come to the draft.

text_blocks.speaker: Kevin Garnett
text_blocks.text: And they made me do two 90-minute workouts by myself. Me and Kiwane Garris. Ask Kiwane, shout to Kiwane. Kiwane got the ball to me.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett recalls Pat Riley and Kevin McHale watching his workout
quotes.excerpt: Pat Riley like, 'Come on, KG, what the fuck are we doing here?'

text_blocks.speaker: Kevin Garnett
text_blocks.text: First there was Pat Riley, second there was Kevin McHale. Pat Riley like, 'Come on, KG, what the fuck are we doing here? You got me up here watching a high school guy, what the fuck is this?'

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: I know that type of energy.

text_blocks.speaker: Kevin Garnett
text_blocks.text: I'm trying to warm up, I'm trying to stretch. 'Come on, can we get this shit going? Got shit to do.' Watching a high school guy, what the fuck is this? Pat Mafia. So as he's doing that, I'm stretching, but I got my back to him. So as he's doing that, I'm like, he don't know why I'm here.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on his mindset during his pre-draft workout
quotes.excerpt: When I went to go shoot the first jumper, I could tell I had so much energy.
quotes.quote: When I went to go shoot the first jumper, I could tell I had so much energy. So I had to relax a little bit, turn down a bit. But when it came to put some energy in the dunking the ball, okay, let's see him jumping and dunk the ball. Okay, that's it. Okay, you can stop. Okay, you can stop. I dunked the ball like nine times. No, why you hitting? No, why you here?

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on his mother's reaction to the NBA draft process
quotes.excerpt: Hey Ma, I need you to do me a favor. I need you to go to the draft with me.

text_blocks.speaker: Kevin Garnett
text_blocks.text: Hey Ma, I need you to do me a favor. I need you to go get your address, I need you to go to the draft with me.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: Draft? What the fuck is the draft? Why you ain't got no diamond in the draft? What you doing? You ain't got no goddamn army boy?

text_blocks.speaker: Kevin Garnett
text_blocks.text: No, Ma, the NBA draft. Boy, I hate my life. Ma, stop for a second. Then my sister had to sit her down and talk to her to tell her what's going on. My Ma then slowed down like, 'What? The draft? What the fuck is this?'

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on discovering his financial responsibilities
quotes.excerpt: That's when I found out I had bills in my name. That's when I found out I had light bills.
quotes.quote: Hey, what the fuck? That's when I found out I had bills in my name. That's when I found out I had light bills, water bills. I want the goddamn water bill too. I want the goddamn water bill too. I'll tell you the shit, bro. I get to the league, boy, I got bills in my name. Damn, what the fuck?

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on his decision to enter the NBA draft without an agent
quotes.excerpt: I didn't hire no agent. I wasn't taking no bread from nobody when nobody finna be owning me.
quotes.quote: I didn't know what to think, so I got real basic and I didn't want to do too much because if I went through a situation and didn't get picked, then I wanted the opportunity to go back to college. So I didn't hire no agent. I wasn't taking no bread from nobody when nobody finna be owning me. So I didn't look like everybody. I wasn't all jazz stuff. I didn't have all the jewelry and shit, but I was in control of free will of me. And everything that went on around me, I controlled it.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on why he fired his agent
quotes.excerpt: It ain't no 4-5% in the method. It's on scale, so 1-2-3, I already know what they going to make.
quotes.quote: It ain't no 4-5% in the method. It's on scale, so 1-2-3, I already know what they going to make. You don't make any money over that, then you get paid what you get paid. So how I'm going to pay you 4% or something that? So that didn't make any sense to me and you didn't say that, so I let him go. And I felt like he was withholding. And yeah, it was a learned lesson early, but I kept it pushing.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on David Stern's impact on the NBA
quotes.excerpt: He was a commissioner, man. He took us international, man. He thought outside the box.
quotes.quote: He was a commissioner, man. He took us international, man. He thought outside the box, but you dealing with 28-30 owners that that are ego and have money and you got to control them, you know what I'm saying? But he grew us. And in times where, yeah, it was hard to grow a sport, you know what I'm saying, if not grow individual. Then he had stars that was bigger than the game, you know what I'm saying? So shout to David Stern, man.
